Full nm and addr2line place that callsite inside QtMaterialFlatButtonStateMachine::qt_metacall(QMetaObject::Call,int,void**).

limits: No CPU time is attributed to individual events or stacks; the passive probe adds overhead and this analysis cannot assign a percentage of process CPU to the halo or drop shadow.

Counts and one initial stack per bounded entry are not an end-to-end causal tag for every paint. The status clock and other updates may also contribute; a controlled same-page counterfactual is needed to quantify impact.

The optimized native call chain elides tail-called setters. The captured native address identifies the state-machine meta-property writer, not a separate captured setHaloScaleFactor frame for each request.
Only the no-argument interposable QWidget::update symbol is counted; overloaded or locally bound library calls can bypass this hook. Paint-event delivery is not full raster/GPU duration.
